providersStore.js.reason: Encrypted credential repository: OS keychain fallback paths and legacy-migration branches are not unit-reachable.
providersStore.js.remediation: Extract the fallback/migration branches behind an injectable keychain and cover them.

providersPayloadSchema.js.reason: Defensive type-coercion branches for hostile payloads are partially unreached.
providersPayloadSchema.js.remediation: Add hostile-payload cases for the remaining coercion branches.

mmxApiKeySync.js.reason: Sync edge cases (concurrent config rewrites, absent key file) branch widely; several OS-level branches are not unit-reachable.
mmxApiKeySync.js.remediation: Inject the config IO to reach the remaining branches.

mmxCredentialBridge.js.reason: Bridge guards for malformed credential payloads are only partially exercised.
mmxCredentialBridge.js.remediation: Cover the remaining malformed-payload guard branches.

deepRedactor.js.reason: One redaction pattern branch remains unreached.

mmxResultRedactor.js.reason: Redactor handles many output shapes; some non-redaction branches unreached.
mmxResultRedactor.js.remediation: Add shape fixtures for the unreached branches.

stateCorruptBackup.js.reason: Backup rotation edge branches (disk-full, locked file) are not unit-reachable.
stateCorruptBackup.js.remediation: Inject fs to simulate rotation failures.

stateSanitizers.js.reason: Sanitizer edge branches for exotic state shapes remain.
stateSanitizers.js.remediation: Add fixtures for the remaining exotic shapes.

state.js.reason: State-store recovery branches for corrupt-then-recover sequences partially unreached.

windowsNamePolicy.js.reason: Reserved-device-name and long-path normalization branches partially unreached (two modules share this filename; waiver applies to both).

pathUtils.js.reason: Cross-drive and UNC-path branches partially unreached.

assetPaths.js.reason: Packaged-vs-dev resolution branches partially unreached in unit scope.
assetPaths.js.remediation: Cover the remaining resolution branches with injected app paths.

config.js.reason: Config discovery fallback chain partially unreached.

batches.js.reason: Batch partition edge branches partially unreached.

jobRegistry.js.reason: Job lifecycle teardown functions not all invoked by unit tests.
jobRegistry.js.remediation: Invoke the remaining lifecycle functions in the registry suite.

cpuGuard.js.reason: Throttle branches for high-core hosts unreached on small runners.
cpuGuard.js.remediation: Inject core counts to reach the remaining branches.
